text:
ellie_g: hey team — trying to apply a trial promo to our org (AcmeWidgets, acct_id: acct_9876) and UI returns "Code invalid or expired". code is `WELCOME50`. Can we check?

maria_support: sorry about that ellie, can you paste the exact code and where you applied it (dashboard vs API)?

ellie_g: pasted into Billing > Credits > Apply promo. also tried the API: `POST /v1/billing/promos/apply {code: "WELCOME50", account: "acct_9876"}` same error.

maria_support: got it. pinging billing and promo-bot to look up the code. @promo-bot any quick details?

promo-bot: lookup result for `WELCOME50` -> status: EXPIRED, expires_at: 1709433600 (2024-02-01 UTC), max_uses: 1, used_count: 1. (source: promotions-service v3)

ellie_g: that seems odd — we were given a new trial link last week from your sales contact. should it not be active?

alex_billing: checking internal issuance logs now. Query: `SELECT id,code,expires_at,max_uses,used_count,scope FROM promotions WHERE code='WELCOME50'` returned: `id=promo_822, scope=single_use_email(acme+trial@acme.com), used_count=1, expires_at=1709433600` — it was a single-use code already consumed.

maria_support: ok looks like the code was scoped to an email and already applied. two options: i) we can issue a replacement promo code ii) grant a one-time credit to acct_9876. which do you prefer?

ellie_g: replacement would be fine, but we need it applied before EOD for our eval. credit is faster if you can just grant it.

jordan_senior: i can do a one-time manual credit. need confirmation of amount. what was promised?

ellie_g: sales said $50 trial credit.

jordan_senior: on it. applying a $50 credit to acct_9876 now. I will post the request id when done.

(jordan_senior later): credit applied — transaction `txn_manual_5531`, amount: $50, expires: 30d from now. ellie, you should see it in Billing > Credits immediately. :thumbsup:

ellie_g: saw it, thanks! that fixed the error path we hit in the UI.

maria_support: follow-up notes for records: root cause = single-use promo previously consumed and scoped to different email. resolution = manual $50 credit grant (txn_manual_5531). sales notified to avoid duplicate issuance.

jordan_senior: adding a note to promotions-service that we should include clearer tooltip in the UI about single-use/scoped promos — filing UX ticket.

ellie_g: appreciated, thanks everyone. closing on our side.

maria_support: closing thread. if anything else pops up, reopen or DM.
